name: clinic-os
description: Repo-root scripts. The apps have their own package.json and their own lockfiles.

scripts.verify: npm run verify:api && npm run verify:web
scripts.verify:api: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/api run test:integration && npm --prefix apps/api run test:no-dotenv && npm --prefix apps/api run test:integration:no-dotenv
scripts.verify:web: npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web test
